@everyone


Upcoming Sale Prep
,
As many of you know, we have recently hinted at the fact that multiple sales are coming! We are very excited about our new Nexus Inventory System which will allow players to equip items that they own. While many details are yet to be released, we have finalized a list of game assets that are coming soon, that range in price starting at $5. Here is a list of items: 


ZeroG Stratos Jetpack
,
ZeroG Stratos Jetpack Solace
,
Scrapyard Jetpack
,
Cargo Backpack (XL)
,
Military Backpack (Medium)
,
Valkryie F9R
,
Bubblejett Super Phantom
,
Scrapyard Racer
,
Premium Outfit M
,
Premium Outfit F
,
Burger Barn Deluxe Goofy Hat
,
Corn Cutie Grizzly Bear Backpack (Medium)
,
Atmos Cargo Ship(this item will not be available this build)
,

We will slowly list these products into the marketplace throughout a 2-3 week period. All sales will be timed. If a product does not sell out, it will be rotated back into the marketplace at a later date until final supply is sold out. Pricing and supply will be announced prior to sales going live, along with additional details.

Stay tuned for more info! (edited)
Saturday, September 28, 2024 at 10:00 AM

@everyone

I have updated the above announcement for now to only showcase the products we plan to sell. We are working internally on structuring the product allocation for each chain and will make an official announcement once we have it finalized. Thank you as always for your feedback! Stay tuned...
